fixture_purpose: Demonstrates that provider_session_resurrection is universally rejected at Phase 0/pre-4, so no unsupported adapter can accidentally accept it. Phase 4 per-adapter enablement is gated by a separate fixture.

evidence.mechanism: mode == 'provider_session_resurrection' returns -32010 provider_session_resurrection_unsupported before any eligibility check, DB write, or adapter dispatch. This is an unconditional early return at the MCP admission layer.
evidence.hold_predicate_prevented: No adapter can accept provider_session_resurrection at Phase 0/pre-4 because the rejection occurs in the shared MCP handler before any adapter-specific code is reached.
